description: This file defines an 'EditorPane' UI component for a note-taking application, using the LightningJS framework. It manages note editing, including title and content editing, autosave functionality, and delete confirmation dialog.

classes.name: EditorPane
classes.description: A LightningComponent used for editing notes, including title and content, with autosave and delete capabilities.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Saves the current note state via NoteService and updates the lastSavedAt timestamp.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets the input focus to the note's title.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets the input focus to the note's content.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Triggers the display of the delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles user confirmation for deleting the note; performs deletion via NoteService.
